press_references.value: Boss Zhipin leverages AI to weed out prostitution job ads

product_launches.description: Boss Zhipin introduced an AI-based risk control system on its recruitment app to detect and block prostitution-related job ads, reportedly blocking 80% of sex-soliciting accounts.

press_references.value: Boss Zhipin targets fake salary listings

product_launches.description: Boss Zhipin, China’s largest direct recruitment app, launched a new campaign aimed at identifying and removing fake high-salary job listings, initially targeting blue-collar roles and later extending to white-collar positions.

press_references.value: Boss Zhipin job board offers AI generated life hacks to keep up traffic

press_references.value: Boss Zhipin leverages AI to match employers and jobseekers for summer part-time jobs

product_launches.description: Boss Zhipin has launched an AI-based 'summer service plan' to help college students find part-time jobs and internships, leveraging AI to match employers and jobseekers during the summer period.

press_references.value: Boss Zhipin launches safe holiday jobs project

product_launches.description: Boss Zhipin has launched a new part-time job security guarantee project called 'anti-fraud combination punch' to protect students seeking holiday jobs.

overview_description.description: BOSS Zhipin is an online recruitment platform in China in terms of average MAU. BOSS Zhipin are a pioneer in introducing a disruptive model which is transforming China’s online recruitment industry – the Direct Recruitment Model. Our mobile-native product promotes instant direct chats between Bosses and job seekers, delivers accurate recommendation results, and is powered by proprietary AI algorithms and big data insights.
